Through: Mr  St  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN MONGA

Petitioners herein seek quashing of FIR No. 899/2020 dated 24.10.2020 lodged under Sections 498A, 406, 34 IPC, registered at Police Station Baba Haridas Nagar based on compromise arrived between the parties vide Settlement Deed dated 30.01.2025 and the consequential proceedings arising therefrom.
2. Dispute between the parties arose from the matrimonial discord between Petitioner No.1 (husband) and complainant/Respondent no.2 (wife).
The Petitioner No.1 and Respondent No. 2 were married on 28.04.2017 according to Hindu rites and one child is born out of the wedlock.
Due to irreconcilable differences, the parties started living separately from 13.04.2018.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/09/2025 at 22:02:47 2.1 Petitioners No. 2 to 4 are the family members of Petitioner No.1.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the parties have amicably settled their dispute vide Settlement Deed dated 30.01.2025 which is placed on record.
4. Parties are present in Court and I have interacted with the complainant/ wife and she has no objection.

Pursuant to the settlement, she points out that marriage also stands dissolved vide a decree dated 25.08.2025 passed by competent Family Court as regards the other part of the compliance of the settlement, she states that the same has been complied with by her ex-husband to Vikas Gulia & Ors vs State Of Nct Of Delhi And Anr on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73661186/
1 her full and final satisfaction.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On a query put to the complainant/ wife, she candidly states that she has entered into the settlement out of her free volition, without any duress or coercion.
She states that she does not wish to press any charges against the petitioners having amicably settled the dispute.
She also states that it has been mutually agreed that the minor girl child shall remain in her exclusive custody.
6. In the aforesaid backdrop, I have heard learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent no. 2 as well as perused the material available on record.

7. Since the complainant/wife does not wish to press charges against the petitioners and there is no incriminating material against them coupled with the fact of compromise, further proceedings before the Court would be an abuse of the process of law.
Especially, when the dispute does not involve any public interest or interest of the society at large
. Continuation of proceedings may rather result in hostility between the parties and defeat the very purpose of settlement.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/09/2025 at 22:02:47 8.
The trial would thus serve no fruitful purpose and will be an exercise in futility.
Whereas non-quashing of the FIR would not only amount to misuse of the judicial process, but also defeat the very object of settlement.
Therefore, further proceedings deserve to be quashed in exercise of the inherent powers of the Court.

Reference in this context may also be made to judgment rendered in the case of Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303].
9.

entities.text: Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, in the larger interest of justice, invoking inherent powers vested with this Court under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023 the FIR No. 899/2020 dated 24.10.2020 lodged under Sections 498A, 406, 34 IPC, registered at Police Station Dwarka and all other proceedings arising there from are quashed.
However, quashing of the FIR and/ or settlement between the parties shall have no bearing on the inheritance rights of the minor.

10. All pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
ARUN MONGA, J SEPTEMBER 2, 2025 kd
